name: recall_cross_file_signature_break
about: A required argument is added and a caller in a file the pull request never touched still passes one. Only the promoted caller in the context bundle makes this findable -- the headline capability.
diff:
diff --git a/invoice.py b/invoice.py
--- a/invoice.py
+++ b/invoice.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
-def calculate_discount(price):
-    return price * 0.9
+def calculate_discount(price, promos):
+    rate = 1 - sum(p.rate for p in promos)
+    return price * rate

findings.title: New promos argument is required, but checkout.py still calls calculate_discount(price)
